Welcome!$(br2)$(2)Occult Cooking$() connects your $(6)Cooking for Blockheads$() kitchen with $(5)Occultism$(), letting you cook straight from your storage network.
A mod that allows you to use items from your $(5)Occultism$() storage network directly in your $(6)Cooking for Blockheads$() kitchen multi-block!$(br2)One new block is added to Minecraft.

The $(l)Occult Kitchen Station$() is the one block you need to bridge $(6)Cooking for Blockheads$() with $(5)Occultism$().$(br2)Placed in your kitchen, it hands your whole $(5)storage network$() to the Cooking Table: every stored item becomes an ingredient.$(br2)Craft it, link it, and drop it into your kitchen. Here's how.

Craft the $(l)Occult Kitchen Station$() as shown.$(br2)Straight out of the grid it isn't tied to anything yet, the next step links it to your $(5)Dimensional Storage Actuator$() so it knows where to pull from.

You link the Station to a $(5)Dimensional Storage Actuator$(), the heart of an Occultism storage system.$(br2)$(l)Sneak-right-click$() the Actuator with the Station in hand and it comes back $(2)linked$().$(br2)The link is saved on the block itself, so the Station keeps reaching the network from any distance, even another dimension, as long as the Actuator's chunk stays loaded.
An example kitchen layout. Tap the eye to preview it in the world.

The Station's screen tells you its status at a glance.$(br2)A $(b)teal glow$() means it's $(2)online$(), the Cooking Table can now cook with everything in your $(5)storage network$().$(br2)A $(4)red-amber$() screen means it's $(l)linked$() to an Actuator but can't reach it right now, usually because the Actuator's chunk isn't loaded.$(br2)A $(8)dark$() screen means it isn't linked at all, sneak-right-click a $(5)Dimensional Storage Actuator$() to link it.
